name: Hear Technologies
old_description: PRO Connect provides a web-based interface to update, conﬁgure, and control your PRO Mixers and PRO Hubs.
about:
Hear Technologies is based in Huntsville, Alabama, where it designs and manufactures personal headphone monitoring systems for professional audio applications. The company develops hardware and software solutions that allow musicians and engineers to create custom monitor mixes in live and studio environments.

Its product line includes the Hear Back PRO system—comprising Hub and Mixer units—the Hear Back OCTO, Switch Back PLUS, Switch Back M8RX, Dante-WSG XS, and Mix Back devices. The Switch Back M8RX combines two functions in a single unit: zero-latency analog mixing of four inputs and Ethernet-based audio networking. The company also provides the PRO Connect web interface for configuring PRO Mixers and Hubs, along with iOS and Android apps for wireless control. Firmware updates and routing capabilities support up to 128 channels of audio per Hub.

Hear Technologies serves the professional audio, live sound, recording studio, touring, and education markets. Its systems have been used by artists such as Marc Broussard, Michael Thompson Band, and Snarky Puppy, as well as facilities including Mercy College, The NuttHouse Recording Studio, Esplanade Studios, and Ray Parker Jr. Studio. The company also partners with Waves SoundGrid for Dante network integration.

The company emphasizes intuitive design and robust capabilities, highlighting that the Switch Back M8RX is effectively two products in one, offering both analog mixing and Ethernet connectivity. Its PRO Connect platform aims to simplify device management through a browser-based interface, while the mobile apps enable remote mixer adjustments during performances.
